posts.headline: Tip
posts.body:
Oil pulling with coconut oil for 10–15 minutes
reduces harmful bacteria by up to 30%.
Ancient practice, modern science confirms it.

posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Stress triggers cortisol, which directs your body to store fat around the belly.
Managing stress is a weight loss strategy.
posts.cta: Belly fat starts in your mind.
